end.gold: Tonight at Isha: pray it as if it were your last.

captions: Yusuf from work. 34. His heart just stopped.
Fresh earth. Your hands up: “Ya Allah, forgive him.”
You promise yourself: from today, I change.
9 p.m. The train home. Phone in your hand.
Episode 4 starts on its own. You let it.
Then, at the top of your chats: Yusuf — “See you Monday, bro.”
You get off one stop early. The mosque is still lit.
Four rak’ahs. No phone. Every word, slowly.
Not a big change. A real one.

post.caption:
3 p.m.: his funeral. 9 p.m.: episode 4. 🤍

Yusuf from work. 34. Fresh earth, your hands up, and a promise: from today, I change. By 9 p.m. the next episode starts on its own — until his last message appears at the top of your chats: “See you Monday, bro.”

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

Tonight at Isha: pray it as if it were your last.
